about: Unit circle trainer (docs/apprecalc-spec.md section 6, builder T3). Every number and problem comes from precalculus/assets/tools/math/unit-circle.js (ApPrecalcMath.unitCircle); contexts unlock with their topics. Checked by scripts/lib/apprecalc-tool-checks/unit-circle.mjs.
intro: Turn a point P around the unit circle. The arc it travels from (1, 0) is the angle θ in radians; its x-coordinate is cos θ, its height is sin θ, and the slope of the radius OP is tan θ. As θ turns, the height and the x-coordinate unroll into the graphs of sine and cosine, drawn on the same scale as the circle.
howItWorks:
• Radians: an angle of θ radians cuts off an arc of length θ on the unit circle (radius 1). On a circle of radius r the arc is s = rθ, so θ = s / r. A full turn is 2π.
  • Coordinates: the terminal ray of θ meets the unit circle at P = (cos θ, sin θ); on a circle of radius r the point is (r cos θ, r sin θ).
  • Tangent: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ, the slope of the radius OP. It is undefined where cos θ = 0 (OP is vertical).
  • Reference angle: the acute angle between the terminal ray and the x-axis. The special angles (multiples of π/6 and π/4) take their sizes from the 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles; the quadrant gives the signs.
  • Keyboard: on the circle, the arrow keys move P to the next special angle (Shift for one degree), Page Up and Page Down by a quarter turn, Home and End to 0 and 2π.
